unit: project media launcher and restricted prompt-to-asset MCP server
scenario: Local SVG exports work while account-backed and remote generation routes are refused
act: Initialize MCP, discover tools, request local logo plan, try forbidden routes, export a known SVG

oracle.source: User requires fully free features with no external sign-in; tools/FREE_MEDIA_PLUGINS.md defines local-only prompt-to-asset
oracle.expected: Exactly ten approved tools; inline_svg is the only advertised/default generation mode; api/external/unlisted calls produce policy errors; the known SVG exports a 32x32 PNG with magenta centre and transparent corners; outgoing fetch/HTTP are blocked
